verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents appointing it as your Registered Agent, including switching from an existing agent, plus a state-by-state compliance dashboard. Its Mailroom virtual mailbox scans physical mail into high-resolution PDFs, but that is presented as a separate virtual-address service rather than the registered agent's own mail handling. Missing for 10: explicit digital delivery of service of process, documentation that registered-agent mail is scanned into the dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
